title: tk skills install + diff
description:
Add install/diff to the tk skills group (files: cmd/tk/cmd/skills_install.go or extend skills.go - follow the pattern the previous tick established; read its code first).

- `tk skills install <name> [--dir PATH]`: writes the skill tree to PATH (default: detect ~/.claude/skills/<name>; --dir for other harnesses). Writes a version stamp file (e.g. .tk-skills-version containing the tk version + install timestamp). REFUSES to overwrite a directory that has no stamp (unmanaged/hand-edited - tell the user to remove it or pass --force); with a stamp, overwrite is the normal upgrade path. --force overrides the unmanaged refusal. Atomic-ish: write to a temp sibling dir then rename over (document the swap semantics; preserve nothing from the old tree).
- `tk skills diff <name> [--dir PATH]`: compares installed tree vs embedded bundle: lists added/removed/changed files and the stamp version vs binary version; exit 0 identical, exit 1 drift (documented in help; explicit ExitError).

Registration/ResetFlags/legacy-switch/testing discipline per .tick/learnings.md (same as the sibling list/get tick). Tests use temp dirs only - NEVER touch the real ~/.claude. Cover: fresh install + stamp, upgrade over stamped dir, refusal on unmanaged dir, --force, diff identical, diff after editing a file, diff version mismatch. Full suite green; gofmt/vet clean. Commit in your worktree with message prefix "tick <this-tick-id>: ".
acceptance_criteria: install writes a loadable skill dir + stamp and refuses unmanaged targets without --force; diff reports drift with exit 1 and identical with 0; all paths tested against temp dirs; legacy dispatch green
